$comment: Paths whose changes need a person's approval even after a verifier passes them (D0008). Everything else merges on a passing verdict.

roles.$comment: Deny rules per agent role (D0019): "agent" applies to every FOREMAN_ACTOR session, "worker", "verifier" and "intake" to actors named after them; a person's session gets none. None here yet. Example: "agent": { "deny": ["Bash(gh pr merge *)", "Bash(ssh *)"] }.
